description: Submit a price match claim when the customer has found the same blind at a lower price elsewhere. Custom Blinds matches verified South African retailer prices for identical product, dimensions, and specs. Returns a pre-filled WhatsApp link to the claims team. Not applicable to: clearance or flash-sale prices, or out-of-stock items. Requires product_id and competitor_price_zar at minimum.

competitor_url.description: URL to competitor product page or quote

product_id.description: Product the customer wants to match (e.g. roller-blockout)

name: request_price_match
